about: Bedrock sound categories of upstream's sound events, from the SoundSource that upstream's playSound call sites use (Java SoundSource -> Bedrock category: BLOCKS block, HOSTILE hostile, NEUTRAL neutral, PLAYERS player, AMBIENT ambient, WEATHER weather, RECORDS record, MUSIC music). tools/sounds/baseline/generate.ps1 applies, in order: 'events' (exact ids or wildcards), then music.* music, music_disc.* record, block.* block, item.* player (the user of an item is a player: Player.playSound and player.getSoundSource() are PLAYERS), and entity.gloamingforest.<mob>.* the mob's own SoundSource, read from upstream's entity classes (HOSTILE for subclasses of Monster, Spider, Zombie, AbstractSkeleton, Ghast and Slime, NEUTRAL for every other Mob; 'entities' maps the event names that are not entity ids). Where upstream plays an event with several sources, the source of its main call site wins ('why').
